edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares shall be USD 42,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), subject to adjustment at Closing for cash, indebtedness, and working capital, in each case against target amounts to be mutually agreed in writing following review of relevant financial information and diligence. The adjustment mechanics, including the treatment of any excess or shortfall, shall be set out in a mutually agreed schedule. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price, as so adjusted, less the amount deposited into escrow, to the Seller in immediately available funds. For discussion, the Seller proposes an escrow equal to 5% of the Purchase Price, to be held for 12 months after Closing solely to secure the Seller’s covered indemnification obligations under this Agreement, on terms to be mutually agreed. No amount may be withheld, deducted, or set off except as expressly provided in the agreed escrow arrangements or pursuant to a final, non-appealable determination of a competent court.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur after satisfaction or waiver, to the extent permitted by law, of the conditions precedent set out in this Agreement, including delivery of the agreed closing documents, on a date agreed by the parties. The parties shall agree a long-stop date in the definitive Agreement; if Closing has not occurred by that date, either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice, except that a party may not terminate if its breach of this Agreement was the primary cause of the failure to close.

3. Seller Representations; Indemnification. The Seller shall make customary representations and warranties in the definitive Agreement regarding its organization and authority, title to and ownership of the Shares, the financial statements, liabilities, taxes, compliance with applicable law, litigation, and the business, in each case subject to the specific exceptions expressly set forth in the disclosure schedule delivered by the Seller and agreed by the parties at signing. The representations shall include customary qualifications as to knowledge and materiality where appropriate and shall not be qualified by general written disclosure or by information made available to the Buyer except to the extent specifically identified in the disclosure schedule as an exception to the applicable representation. The definitive Agreement shall provide for customary survival periods and indemnification procedures, including an agreed cap, basket, and exclusive-remedy framework, with the escrow serving as the sole source of recovery for ordinary covered indemnification claims, except in cases of fraud.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep confidential the existence and terms of this Agreement and all non-public information received from the other party in connection with the transaction, and shall not disclose such information except to its representatives who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations, or as required by law. A party may also disclose such information to its affiliates, professional advisers, and actual or prospective financing sources and their representatives, in each case only to the extent reasonably necessary for the transaction and subject to confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this Agreement. A party may disclose information to the extent reasonably required in connection with enforcing this Agreement or obtaining financing for the transaction, provided that, where legally permissible and reasonably practicable, it gives the other party prior notice and limits disclosure to what is reasonably necessary. This clause does not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available other than through breach of this Agreement.

receiver.requested_changes: Maintain USD 35 million as the Buyer’s proposal, subject to appropriate closing adjustments. If the Seller is unwilling to agree to that figure now, provide the relevant financial information and diligence materials promptly so the parties can establish cash, indebtedness, and working-capital targets and mechanics; the purchase price and adjustment framework must be considered together, with no assumption that USD 42 million is agreed. Do not treat the proposed 5% escrow, 12-month duration, or any other escrow terms as agreed. Any escrow must be negotiated alongside adequate indemnification protections, including an appropriate cap, basket, survival periods, procedures, and recourse that is not unduly limited to the escrow; preserve appropriate remedies for fraud and other agreed exceptions. The disclosure schedule should contain specific exceptions, and general data-room disclosure should not qualify representations. Please provide customary closing conditions and propose a long-stop date after the expected diligence and closing timetable is known; termination rights should not allow a party to benefit from its own breach. Keep confidentiality exceptions limited to necessary transaction disclosures to appropriately bound recipients, with notice where practicable, and no broader than needed.

Thank you for the revised draft. We note the reduction from USD 45 million to USD 42 million and the proposed closing-adjustment and escrow framework, but USD 42 million is not agreed. The Buyer’s proposal remains USD 35 million, subject to a properly defined adjustment for cash, indebtedness, and working capital. Please provide the financial information and diligence materials needed to establish the targets and mechanics; we can then discuss the overall economics on an informed basis.

We also note that the proposed 5% escrow, 12-month term, and long-stop date remain open, as do the adjustment schedule and other definitive terms. We are prepared to discuss a reasonable escrow, but not an arrangement that makes it the sole source of recovery for ordinary indemnification claims without appropriate protections and exceptions. The revised approach to specific disclosure-schedule exceptions and customary closing conditions is a useful basis for further drafting. Please send the relevant information and a proposed timetable, and we can discuss the remaining terms promptly.
